Rashi on Nazir 16b:1:1.hebrew: נטמא יום שלשים סותר את הכל ולא פליג ר' אליעזר דהא קאמר שלימין - ואפילו לבר פדא, דאכתי תוך מלאת קרינא ביה:
Rashi on Nazir 16b:1:1.english: [If] he became impure on the thirtieth day, it negates the entire [tally], and Rabbi Eliezer does not disagree, for he said full [days] - And [this applies] even according to Bar Padda, as we still apply to it [the status of] "within the completion [of his term]."

Rashi on Nazir 16b:2:1.english: [If] he became impure on the one hundredth day, it negates the entire [tally] - For we read concerning him [that he is] within [the days of] completion.

Rashi on Nazir 16b:2:2.hebrew: רבי אליעזר אומר לא סותר אלא שלשים - כדאמר ר"ל בפ"ק (לעיל נזיר ד' ו:), דטעמא דר' אליעזר משום דקאמר קרא: "זאת תורת הנזיר ביום מלאת" — התורה אמרה: נטמא ביום מלאת, תן לו תורת נזיר; ואפי' בנזירות מרובה:
Rashi on Nazir 16b:2:2.english: Rabbi Eliezer says: It negates only thirty - As Reish Lakish said in the first chapter (above, Nazir 6b), Rabbi Eliezer's reason is because the verse states: "This is the law of the nazirite, on the day of completion" — the Torah said: [If] he became impure on the day of completion, give him the law of a [standard] nazirite; and [this applies] even to an extended naziriteship.

Rashi on Nazir 16b:2:3.hebrew: וכולה - טעמא דמתניתין עד השתא, כדהוינן בה אליבא דבר פדא ורב מתנא בפ"ק (ד' ה וד' ו):
Rashi on Nazir 16b:2:3.english: And all of it - The reasoning of the Mishnah up to this point [is] as we discussed it according to Bar Padda and Rav Mattana in the first chapter (daf 5 and daf 6).

Rashi on Nazir 16b:3:1.hebrew: מי שנזר והוא בבית הקברות אפי' הוא עומד שם שלשים יום אינן עולין לו מן המנין - כלומר, אין עולין לכך שתהא חלה עליו אותו נזירות שקיבל כשנטמא, ואין מביא קרבן טומאה:
Rashi on Nazir 16b:3:1.english: One who took a vow of naziriteship while in a cemetery, even if he remains there thirty days, they do not count for him toward the tally - That is to say, [the days] do not count so that that naziriteship which he accepted while impure should take effect upon him, and [therefore] he does not bring an offering of impurity.

Rashi on Nazir 16b:3:2.hebrew: יצא ונכנס - כגון שהזה ושנה וטבל, כדמפרש בגמרא, ואח"כ נכנס — עולים לו למנין נזירות; דכיון [שהזה] ושנה וטבל ביום שביעי שלו, מביא קרבן על הטומאה:
Rashi on Nazir 16b:3:2.english: [If] he left and entered - For example, where he was sprinkled, and repeated [the sprinkling], and immersed, as the Gemara explains, and afterward entered — [the days] count for him toward the tally of naziriteship; for since [he was sprinkled], and repeated [the sprinkling], and immersed on his seventh day, he brings an offering for the impurity.

Rashi on Nazir 16b:4:1.hebrew: רבי אליעזר אומר לא בו ביום - כשהזה ושנה וטבל, אם נכנס, אינו מביא קרבן טומאה עד שיעבור עליו ב' ימים בטהרה, שנאמר: ״והימים הראשונים יפלו״. אימתי? לכשאני קורא מקרא זה שיהיו לו ימים הראשוני' דטהרה, ואין ימים פחותים משנים:
Rashi on Nazir 16b:4:1.english: Rabbi Eliezer says: Not on that very day - When he sprinkled [the purification water], repeated [the sprinkling], and immersed, if he entered [the cemetery again], he does not bring an offering of impurity until two days pass for him in purity, as it is stated: “And the first days shall be void.” When [does this apply]? When I can apply this verse [to him], that he has “first days” of purity; and “days” is no fewer than two.

Rashi on Nazir 16b:5:1.hebrew: איתמר מי שנזר והוא בבית הקברות ר' יוחנן אמר נזירות חל עליו - דקסבר, דהאי מאן דמקבל נזירות בבית הקברות מיתלא תליא וקיימא. וכיון דמשכחת טהרה — דהיינו לאחר שיצא, והזה ושנה וטבל — חיילא עליה, אע"ג דלא הדר אמר: אני אקבל עלי מה שאמרתי כשהייתי עומד בבית הקברות:
Rashi on Nazir 16b:5:1.english: It was stated: One who vowed to be a nazirite while in a cemetery, Rabbi Yoḥanan said: Naziriteship takes effect for him - For he holds that [in the case of] this person who accepts naziriteship in a cemetery, [the naziriteship] remains suspended; and once it finds purity — that is, after he has left, was sprinkled [on the third day], repeated [the sprinkling on the seventh day], and immersed — it takes effect upon him, even though he did not again say: "I accept upon myself what I said when I was standing in the cemetery."

Rashi on Nazir 16b:5:2.hebrew: ור"ל אמר - אי הדר אמר: ״אהא כמו שקבלתי בבית הקברות״ — חייל עליה, ואע"ג דלא מפרש ״אהא נזיר״. ואי לא — לא, שאם נטמא למתים ושותה יין, אין בכך כלום:
Rashi on Nazir 16b:5:2.english: And Reish Lakish said - If he again says, “I shall be as I accepted in the cemetery,” it takes effect upon him, even though he does not explicitly state, “I shall be a nazirite.” And if not, [it does] not [take effect] — for if he became defiled by corpses or drinks wine, there is nothing to it.

Rashi on Nazir 16b:6:1.hebrew: א"ל - מסקנא דמתניתין בהכי הוי: דמי שנזר בבית הקברות אינו בתורת טומאה, ואינו בתורת קרבן טהרה — ליסתור ולהביא קרבן טהרה — לפי שאין נזירות חל עליו כלל:
Rashi on Nazir 16b:6:1.english: [Reish Lakish] said to him - The conclusion of the Mishnah is as follows: That one who took a vow of naziriteship in a cemetery is not subject to the law of ritual impurity, nor is he subject to the law of an offering of purity — to forfeit [days] and bring an offering of purity — because naziriteship does not take effect upon him at all.

Rashi on Nazir 16b:7:1.english: One who was impure and took a vow of naziriteship - That is, [this is] also [the case of] one who is standing in a cemetery.

Tosafot on Nazir 16b:1:1.hebrew: קסבר ר"א כל אחר מלאת ז' סותר - ולכך אומר דהריני נזיר סתם ונטמא יום שלשים [דאינו] סותר, דלאחר מלאת הוא: לרב מתנא — משום דאמר מקצת היום ככולו, ולבר פדא — מיום כ"ט נשלם נזירותו:
Tosafot on Nazir 16b:1:1.english: Rabbi Eliezer holds: Any [impurity] after completion negates seven [days] - And therefore [the Mishnah] states that [if one said,] “I am hereby a nazirite” unspecified and became impure on the thirtieth day, [he does not] negate [the whole tally], because it is after completion: according to Rav Mattana, because he says [that] part of the day is like the whole of it; and according to Bar Padda, his naziriteship was completed from the twenty-ninth day.

Tosafot on Nazir 16b:1:2.hebrew: לא פליג ר"א דאמר שלימים - לרב מתנא, חשיב ליה כאילו אמר שלימים, ולא אמר "מקצת היום ככולו"; הילכך סותר הכל. ולבר פדא נמי, כי אמר שלשים בפירוש חשיב כאילו אמר שלימים, דלא אמר "מקצת היום ככולו"; הילכך לא פליג ר"א כלל:
Tosafot on Nazir 16b:1:2.english: "Rabbi Eliezer does not disagree, since he said full [days]" - According to Rav Matna, it is considered as though he said full [days], and he does not say [that] part of the day is like the whole of it; therefore, it negates the entire tally. And according to Bar Pada as well, when he explicitly said "thirty," it is considered as though he said full [days], since he does not say [that] part of the day is like the whole of it; therefore, Rabbi Eliezer does not disagree at all.

Tosafot on Nazir 16b:3:1.hebrew: מי שנדר והוא בבית הקברות - וה"ה אם היה טמא ונדר, ובגמ' מדמה להו:
Tosafot on Nazir 16b:3:1.english: One who vowed while in a cemetery - And the same law applies if he was ritually impure and vowed [naziriteship], and in the Gemara [it] compares them.

Tosafot on Nazir 16b:3:2.hebrew: ואפי' היה שם ל' אין עולין לו מן המנין - לענין דמונה והולך, דאינו מביא קרבן טומאה, דרחמנא מיעטיה מקרבן [כדמפרש] בגמרא. אבל הא פשיטא דהימים אינן עולין, דאפי' מנה בטהרה ונטמא סותר את הראשונים, וכ"ש שאין עולין לו כי טמא מעיקרא:
Tosafot on Nazir 16b:3:2.english: "Even if he was there for thirty [days], they do not count for him in the tally" - [This is taught] with regard to [the fact] that he counts onward and does not bring an offering of impurity, for the Merciful One excluded him from [bringing an] offering, [as is explained] in the Gemara. However, this is obvious, that the days do not count [toward his naziriteship], for even if one counted [days] in purity and [subsequently] became ritually impure, he negates the earlier [days], and all the more so they do not count for him when he was impure from the outset.

Tosafot on Nazir 16b:3:3.hebrew: יצא ונכנס עולה לו מן המנין - מפרש בגמ': "יצא ונכנס" — והזה ושנה, ונכנס בו ביום שטבל בשביעי. "עולין מן המנין" — לענין זה: כשנטמא, סותר אותו מנין, ומתחייב (אותו) קרבן טומאה, דבאותו יום עצמו מתחיל נזירות טהרה. ובגמרא פליגי ר' יוחנן ור"ל: כשנטהר, אם צריך לחזור ולקבל נזירות, או סגי ליה במה שקיבל בימי טומאתו:
Tosafot on Nazir 16b:3:3.english: "If he left and entered, it counts for him toward the tally" - [The Gemara] explains in the Gemara: "He left and entered" — [meaning] he had [purification water] sprinkled [upon him on the third day] and repeated [on the seventh], and entered on the very day that he immersed on the seventh [day]. "They count toward the tally" — regarding this matter: that when he becomes impure, he negates that tally and becomes obligated in (that) offering of ritual impurity, for on that very day itself the ritually pure naziriteship begins. And in the Gemara, Rabbi Yoḥanan and Reish Lakish disagree: when he becomes pure, whether he must repeat and accept naziriteship, or whether what he accepted during the days of his impurity is sufficient for him.

Tosafot on Nazir 16b:4:1.hebrew: ר"א אומר לא בו ביום - כלומר: אם נכנס בו ביום שנטהר — אין מביא קרבן טומאה עד יום שני שהתחיל הטהרה, שנאמר: "והימים הראשונים יפלו", דבעינן בסותר שיסתור ב' ימים, דאז מביא קרבן טומאה. וה"ה דמצי למיתני פלוגתייהו בנזיר טהור שנטמא ביום ראשון של קבלת נזירותו, וביום נטמא בתחילה — דלרבנן מביא קרבן טומאה, ולר"א אינו מביא קרבן טומאה, אלא מונה ז' ימי טומאה ומזה ושונה וטובל, ומונה כ"ט יום ליום הראשון שמנה, ומגלח ביום ל', שהוא ל' ואחד לנזירותו:
Tosafot on Nazir 16b:4:1.english: Rabbi Eliezer says: Not on the very day - That is to say, if he entered [the cemetery] on the very day that he became pure, he does not bring an offering of impurity until the second day from when he began [his state of] purity, as it is stated: "But the first days shall be void" (Numbers 6:12), for regarding one who negates [his tally], we require that he negate [at least] two days, as only then does he bring an offering of impurity. And the same applies [in that the Mishnah] could have taught their dispute regarding a pure nazirite who became impure on the first day of his acceptance of naziriteship, and on [that] day he became impure initially — that according to the Rabbis he brings an offering of impurity, and according to Rabbi Eliezer he does not bring an offering of impurity; rather, he counts seven days of impurity, and is sprinkled [with the purification water on the third day] and repeated [on the seventh], and immerses, and counts twenty-nine days [in addition] to the first day that he counted, and shaves on the thirtieth day, which is the thirty-first [day] of his naziriteship.

Tosafot on Nazir 16b:5:1.hebrew: רבי יוחנן אמר נזירות חלה עליו - לכל מילי; ולוקה בעודו שם אטומאה אם התרו בו לצאת ממנו (יוצא), ואתגלחת, ואשתיית יין. וכשיטהר, אין צריך לחזור ולקבל עליו נזירות:
Tosafot on Nazir 16b:5:1.english: Rabbi Yoḥanan said: Naziriteship takes effect for him - In all respects; and he is flogged while still there for ritual impurity if they warned him to leave it (leaves), and for shaving, and for drinking wine. And when he becomes pure, he does not need to accept naziriteship upon himself again.

Tosafot on Nazir 16b:5:2.hebrew: מיתלא תליא וקאי - ומ"מ, נ"ל דאסור:
Tosafot on Nazir 16b:5:2.english: "It is pending" - And nevertheless, it appears to me that [he is] forbidden [from the prohibitions of naziriteship].

Tosafot on Nazir 16b:5:3.hebrew: וכי משכחת טהרה חייל - פירוש: דין נזירות טהרה לענין הבאת קרבן מיתלא תליא וקאי עד שיצא משם ויטהר, וכי יטהר חייל ממילא עליה לענין הבאת קרבן. ובקיצור, הוה מצי למימר דחייל עליה נזירות מהשתא, ולקי על תגלחת ויין וטומאה:
Tosafot on Nazir 16b:5:3.english: "And when purity is found, it takes effect" - Explanation: The law of a naziriteship of purity regarding the bringing of an offering is suspended and pending until he leaves from there and purifies himself; and when he becomes pure, it takes effect automatically upon him regarding the bringing of an offering. And more concisely, [the Gemara] could have said that naziriteship takes effect upon him from now, and he is flogged for shaving, [drinking] wine, and [contracting] ritual impurity.

Tosafot on Nazir 16b:5:4.hebrew: וריש לקיש אמר אין נזירות חייל עליה - בעודו טמא, עד שיטהר, ואז יצטרך לחזור ולקבל עליו הנזירות. ובקונטרס פי' דבקבלה מועטת סגי לומר "יחול עליו הנזירות" — אומר: "הריני כמו שנדרתי". ובפ"ק דנדרים (דף ד.) אמרי' לר"ל, דעובר בבל תאחר אם אינו מקבל נזירות עליו מיד כשיטהר:
Tosafot on Nazir 16b:5:4.english: "And Reish Lakish said: Naziriteship does not take effect for him" - [Meaning,] while he is impure, until he becomes pure, and then he will need to again accept the naziriteship upon himself. And in the Kunteres [Rashi] it was explained that a minimal acceptance is sufficient for naziriteship to take effect upon him: he says, "I am hereby as I vowed." And in the first chapter of Nedarim (4a), we say according to Reish Lakish that he violates [the prohibition of] "you shall not delay" if he does not accept naziriteship upon himself immediately once he becomes pure.

Tosafot on Nazir 16b:6:1.hebrew: קרבן טומאה הוא דלא מייתי - דמעטיה קרא לקמן; הא מיחל חייל עליה נזירות, לענין דלקי אטומאה, אתגלחת, ואיין:
Tosafot on Nazir 16b:6:1.english: It is the offering of impurity that he does not bring - For Scripture excluded him [from this] later on; but [as for] taking effect, naziriteship does take effect upon him, with regard to being lashed for ritual impurity, for shaving, and for wine.

Tosafot on Nazir 16b:6:2.hebrew: א"ל אינו בתורת טומאה - דלא חייל נזירות כלל:
Tosafot on Nazir 16b:6:2.english: [Reish Lakish] said to him: "He is not in the category of ritual impurity" - That naziriteship does not take effect at all.
